name: @volter/twin-vercel
description: Local Vercel twin (Protocol 3): a project's customer domains as Dub and cal.com add, read, verify, configure and remove them (their configuration read from the owner's DNS, a verification only when another account holds the apex), a team domain made a Vercel DNS zone, Edge Config written through the API and read at edge-config.vercel.com, and the dashboard's email sign-in, Account Tokens and Storage pages.
author: Volter (https://github.com/volter-ai)
